# Trivio — Payment Settlement Intelligence

Welcome to the official GitHub organization for **Trivio** (`trivio.ink`).

Trivio is a developer-first payment settlement intelligence platform. We build deterministic, type-safe calculation engines and integration SDKs that empower developers to model, calculate, and reconcile complex payment gateway settlements without surrendering data ownership.

---

## ⚡ Core Principles

- **Developer-Owned Payment Data:** Your transaction records, customer details, and ledgers remain in your database. Our SDKs run locally within your infrastructure.
- **Zero-Dependency Financial Primitives:** Mathematical calculations are built on zero-float, minor-currency unit arithmetic with integer precision.
- **Deterministic Settlement Projections:** Pure calculation models eliminate reconciliation discrepancies and prevent hidden processor deductions.

## 🔒 Security & Privacy

Trivio never handles raw primary account numbers (PAN), CVVs, or cardholder credentials in its generic libraries. To report security vulnerabilities, review our [Security Policy](https://github.com/trivio-ink/trivio-platform/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
